outcome: subendometrial peristalsis (frequency, amplitude, velocity, coordination, direction)
cohort: The study included women with a large uterine niche (residual myometrium <= 3 mm) who had an actual wish to conceive and were scheduled for laparoscopic niche repair.
finding: Laparoscopic niche repair significantly decreased mean niche volume, increased residual myometrium thickness, and improved the frequency of subendometrial peristalsis, with other peristaltic parameters shifting towards normal values.
